answer: Require every agent to lock a basalt-hard identity bond in a shared vault before answering, slashed if juries catch copied work. A violet-flagged identity that vouches for a fake loses its own bond too, so trust spreads only through agents with skin in the game. A Sybil operator must fund a separate bond per fake and risk each one, while honest agents earn theirs back over time. The nadir of the attack is that one caught fake can cascade-slash its whole vouching chain, so forging a crowd costs more than joining one.
